description: This file defines a static class 'DbConstantsStore' that maintains database-specific constants and provides utility methods for determining capabilities of different ADO.NET database providers, such as support for command cancellation, streaming, and whether the implementation is synchronous. It also defines a 'DbConstants' class to encapsulate these properties.

classes.name: DbConstants
classes.description: A class encapsulating database-specific constants such as escape characters, query templates, and feature support flags.

methods.name: GetDbConstants
methods.description: Retrieves the DbConstants instance associated with a given provider invariant name.

methods.name: SupportsCommandCancellation
methods.description: Checks if the given storage or provider supports command cancellation.

methods.name: SupportsStreamNatively
methods.description: Checks if the given storage or provider supports native streaming.

methods.name: IsSynchronousAdoNetImplementation
methods.description: Determines if the ADO.NET implementation for a given provider is synchronous.

methods.name: GetDatabaseCommandInterceptor
methods.description: Returns the command interceptor associated with a specific provider invariant name.
